BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No 8-H in an area bounded by:

A line 384 feet south of and parallel to West 33" Street; South Damen Avenue; the
northeasterly right-of-way line of the Golf, Mobile, and Ohio Railroad ; and the public alley
next west of and parallel to South Damen Avenue

to those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 3338 S. Damen Avenue
